page_title: IntelliJ IDEA: Java and Kotlin IDE for You and Your Agents

sources.entry: IntelliJ IDEA - Powerful IDE for JVM languages. (Free for Students)

summary.name: IntelliJ IDEA
summary.one_liner: JetBrains' Java and Kotlin IDE that lets you run AI agents alongside code intelligence, debugging, testing and profiling tools to verify their changes.
use_cases: Writing and refactoring Java or Kotlin code
Running multiple AI coding agents on one project
Safely renaming methods across a large codebase
Debugging, testing and profiling JVM applications
Reviewing agent diffs and sending comments back
summary.what_it_does: The page describes IntelliJ IDEA as a Java and Kotlin IDE for working with AI agents. Users can choose whether each agent launches in the GUI or terminal and whether the IDE shows code or the agent session. Several agents can run at once across one or more projects, and a session view shows which are running, done, or waiting. Debugging, testing, profiling and database tools are available for checking changes. The page says its code intelligence resolves usages, dependencies and types across the codebase, and gives an illustrative example of a safe rename taking 2 tool calls versus 105 with grep-and-edit.
notable: Code intelligence that resolves usages, dependencies and types to guide agents and safe refactors
Session view tracking running, done, or waiting agent sessions
Bring your own API key, existing subscription, or JetBrains AI
Free tier with 30 days of Ultimate included
caveats: The 105 vs 2 tool call comparison is labeled as an illustrative example, not a measured result
Free tier is stated; Ultimate features are only trialed for 30 days, and the page does not detail which features are paid
